Name: Pac-Man Kart Rally
Description: A kart racer set in the Pac-Man world, with power pellets to collect and ghosts loose on the track.

Achievements.Name: One Step Ahead
Achievements.Description: Finish 3 races 1 lap before at least 1 opponent.

Achievements.Name: Dotted Line
Achievements.Description: Finish an Expert Tournament Race with 10 Pac-Dots.

Achievements.Name: Gear Head
Achievements.Description: Unlock all karts and all kart upgrades.

Achievements.Name: Drift Away
Achievements.Description: Perform 8 drift boosts in a single race.

Achievements.Name: Champion
Achievements.Description: Win all the cups on 1st place.

Achievements.Name: Hardcore
Achievements.Description: Finish 3 races without using any power-ups.

Achievements.Name: Mission Accomplished
Achievements.Description: Complete all the missions in Challenge Mode.

Achievements.Name: I Will Survive
Achievements.Description: Place 1st in each lap in a Survival Race.

Achievements.Name: Karting King
Achievements.Description: Complete the Tournament on Expert difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Record Breaker
Achievements.Description: Beat your own record 3 times on any track.

Achievements.Name: Classic Pac-Man
Achievements.Description: Eat all the ghosts in a Chase Race.
